title: Reflecting on 25 Years Since 9/11 Attacks
summary: Mark Jacobson, International Spy Museum Historian and retired US Navy Intelligence Officer, shares his experience being inside the Pentagon on September 11, 2001. He recalls being near the point of impact, and the difficulties in getting in touch with his family to let them know he had survived. Jacobson also discusses how well equipped the country is to prevent another terrorist attack and reflects on how counterterrorism has evolved in the past 25 years, saying that while overall we are more secure than we were 25 years ago, he's worried about "the fact that we are undervaluing our allies." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Mexican Government Slashes Pemex Aid by 70% in New Budget

title: Xerox Shareholder Pushes for Activist Changes at Company
summary: Bloomberg's Mengqi Sun joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." A significant shareholder in Xerox is pushing the company to take action to unlock shareholder value and is asking for a strategic review of its financial services business. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Husband & Wife Explore Sale of $37B Credit Firm
summary: Bloomberg's Matt Monks joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." Palmer Square Capital Management is a $37 billion credit firm run by the husband-wife duo Chris and Angie Long. And the couple is exploring a sale of the business. Under their leadership, the firm has grown to become one of the biggest issuers of collateralized loan obligations. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AI Can Create Massive Opportunities For All Of Us: Shah
summary: Ajay Shah, chairman of global technology investment banking at Deutsche Bank Securities, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." An AI researcher has resigned from Anthropic and called on other staffers to rethink their work, citing his concern that the company and its top competitor OpenAI are acting irresponsibly in their all-out pursuit of a technology that poses existential risks to humanity. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Signet Jewelers CEO on 2Q Results & Trends To Watch
summary: J.K. Symancyk, CEO of Signet Jewelers, said the company feels confident after raising guidance for a second time this year, pointing to solid fundamentals, five positive comparable-sales quarters in the last six, and momentum heading into the important fourth quarter. He said Wall Street had expected a guidance boost, but Signet’s confidence is based on broad business strength rather than a one-time benefit. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Tyler Kendall on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: HOF Consortium Completes Purchase of Bugatti
summary: Hisham Elhaddad, co-founder and managing partner of HOF Capital, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." Porsche said it will generate about €1 billion ($1.16 billion) from the sale of its stake in the venture that owns the Bugatti supercar brand. Under the transaction, Porsche fully divested its equity stake in Bugatti Rimac and its 20.6% holding in Rimac Group. Porsche closed the sale to a consortium led by HOF Capital. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Stocks Fall as Oil Jump, Treasury Plan Lift Yields: Markets Wrap
summary: A resurgence in oil prices drove stocks and bonds lower, with losses deepening as the Treasury said it will purchase up to $6 billion of longer-dated government debt.

title: SpaceX IPO Paved The Way For Anthropic: Kennedy
summary: Lise Buyer, partner and founder at Class V Group, Ajay Shah, chairman of global technology investment banking at Deutsche Bank Securities, and Matt Kennedy, senior strategist at Renaissance Capital, joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." Anthropic is set to finalize an expansion of its revolving credit facility to $15 billion, according to people familiar with the matter, clearing a hurdle before the AI firm’s public filing for its highly anticipated IPO. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Treasury Yields Climb After New Buyback Targets Disappoint
summary: US government bonds fell after the Treasury Department announced target sizes for its expanded buyback program short of the levels some strategists said were possible.

title: Crude Tops $101 as US-Iran War Escalates With Tankers Targeted
summary: Brent oil topped $101 a barrel for the first time since July, as escalating attacks across the Middle East heightened concerns about further disruptions to energy flows out of the crude-rich region.

title: Canada’s Enbridge Said to Near Deal for Major US Oil Pipeline
summary: Enbridge Inc., the Canadian energy infrastructure giant, is in advanced talks to buy a major crude oil pipeline in the US from Blackstone Inc.’s Tallgrass Energy for about $2 billion, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: GE to Buy Consolidated Precision Products for $11.75B
summary: Bloomberg's Kiel Porter joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." GE Aerospace agreed to buy castings manufacturer Consolidated Precision Products from Warburg Pincus and Berkshire Partners for $11.75 billion, a deal that will significantly expand the jet-engine manufacturer’s capacity for the critical components. (Source: Bloomberg)
